digest.component_or_area: CLI command flags (edit and claim) with plan-review gate integration
propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, then invoke review_plan after the EDIT event commits and exit with disposition code (0/1/2/11) based on the review verdict

claim --review must check gate applicability via _plan_review_gate_applies and claim_gate_check, proceed to claim only on PASS verdict, exit with disposition codes (1/2/11) on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable without invoking the claim core, and print a skip notice when the gate does not apply

Both flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import, release the store lock before the multi-minute LLM review runs, allow review_plan exceptions to propagate through the standard CLI error path, and leave the edit committed even if review fails
The --review flag must not propagate through the parent-first cascade for either command and is CLI-only (blocked by REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM fence)

Help sources (edit.txt, claim.txt) must document non-atomicity against concurrent store reconvergence and reference review-plan --status; docs/cli-reference.md and docs/exit-codes.md must be updated and regenerated
